title: Vendor Performance Note: Delay-Length Rate of the Ridgeline Special Order Services Delay Credit on Deposit Programs
content:
The longer the vendor's delay on a Ridgeline Special Order Services order in a program whose deposit at order is 50 percent, the higher the rate at which the delay credit is figured.

**Clause.** The delay is the number of calendar days by which the estimated ready date — or the ready date, once the item is ready — is later than the promised ready date, and 0 when not later. The delay rate depends on that delay: more than twice the program's vendor delay threshold gives a delay rate of 7.5 percent; more than 1.5 times the threshold and not more than twice it gives 6 percent; otherwise the delay rate is the program's delay credit percentage.

The delay rate is the percentage of the credit base at which the delay credit is figured.

## Bands for the deposit programs

| Program | Threshold (days) | 7.5 percent | 6 percent | Program percentage (5) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Ridgeline Special Order Windows and Exterior Doors | 21 | more than 42 days | 32 to 42 days | 31 days or fewer |
| Ridgeline Special Order Semi-Custom Cabinetry | 21 | more than 42 days | 32 to 42 days | 31 days or fewer |
| Ridgeline Special Order Fabricated Countertops | 14 | more than 28 days | 22 to 28 days | 21 days or fewer |

For a threshold of 21 days, 1.5 times the threshold is 31.5 days, so a delay of 31 days is not more than it and a delay of 32 days is; for a threshold of 14 days it is 21 days exactly.

## Boundary dates (hypothetical Windows and Exterior Doors order, promised ready date 13 April)

| Estimated or actual ready date | Delay | Delay rate |
|---|---|---|
| 14 May | 31 | 5 |
| 15 May | 32 | 6 |
| 25 May | 42 | 6 |
| 26 May | 43 | 7.5 |
